displayName.ja: 【マスクドフォーム】 詩嶋　麦

profile.ja: 対魔忍。昔からヒーローに憧れて修業に励んでいたが、彼女の能力は普通には開花しないと言われ悩んでいた。しかし、敵に襲われて危機に陥った折、仲間を救うために対魔粒子を高めて敵に突っ込んだことをきっかけに“対魔法衣”――対魔粒子をスーツと化して纏い、攻撃、防御、スピードなどを驚異的に上げる術に目覚めた。この事件をきっかけに対魔忍として開花した彼女は、卒業後も各地で大活躍している。努力家で常日頃から訓練を欠かさず、鍛錬や実戦からのフィードバックを頻繁に更新する麦は、五車上層部からの評価も高い。だが、麦としては『ヒーローが努力し、訓練する姿が格好良い』ので、如何に憧れのヒーローに自身を近づけるかに時間を割いている。プライベートの時間には特撮やアニメ、アクション映画等の鑑賞に没頭し、理想のヒーロー像を自身の中で構築していく。麦の忍法は本人の持つイメージが重要なので、このイメージトレーニングはかなり有効である。自身の中で作り上げた最高のヒーローに近い対魔法衣を纏った麦の能力は飛躍的に向上し、モチベーションも爆上がりするのだった。なお、最近は米連製のヒーローがマイブームになっている模様。
profile.en: Shijima Mugi is a Taimanin who has long idolized heroes and trained tirelessly, though she was told her abilities would never fully blossom. During a mission training exercise, her team was ambushed and a comrade was in danger. Despite sustaining serious injuries herself, Mugi amplified all her Taimanin particles and threw herself at the enemy in a self-sacrificial charge. The foes tried to crush her like a summer insect caught in flame, but the maximally heightened particles formed a protective garment around her, dramatically boosting her physical abilities. She swept the enemies away. Her ninjutsu, called "Taimanin Armor," transforms Taimanin particles into a suit that dramatically enhances attack, defense, and speed. This incident triggered her full emergence as a Taimanin. After graduating, she has been active across the land. However, her ability consumes massive energy and lasts only thirty minutes; without a break she cannot transform again. She is a hard worker who never skips training and frequently updates her skills with feedback from battles. As a result, she has received high praise from the upper echelons of the Gosha. Mugi believes that a hero's efforts and training are what make them attractive, so she spends her time trying to get closer to her ideal hero. In her private time, she immerses herself in special effects, anime, action movies, and other media to build her ideal image of a hero. This image training is very effective for her, as her ninjutsu relies heavily on her own imagination. When she wears her Taimanin Armor, which is closest to her ideal hero, her abilities increase dramatically, and her motivation soars. Recently, she has been fascinated with American heroes.

detail.ja: 部隊全体のSPDを中アップ

text.ja: お待たせ、隊長！　って言っても、このマスクだと、誰かわからないかな？　マスクドフォームになった、新しい詩嶋麦よ！
text.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Captain! But even if I say that, you probably can't tell who I am with this mask on, right? I'm the new, masked Shijima Mugi!

text.ja: いつもの対魔法衣と違って、顔が結構出ちゃってるけど……このマスクがあれば、私ってわからないでしょ？
text.en: Unlike my usual Taimanin Armor, my face is pretty exposed this time... but with this mask, you can't tell it's me, right?

text.ja: 今回のフォームは、外見より、能力のイメージを重視したからね……性能も、格段に向上してるのよ
text.en: This time, I prioritized the image of my abilities over my appearance... and my performance has improved dramatically.

text.ja: うっ……さすが隊長、お見通しね……そうよ。イメージ構築のために、特撮だけじゃなくて、米連のヒーローもチェックしたの
text.en: Ah, Captain, you see right through me... yes, that's right. To build my image, I've been checking out not just special effects, but also American heroes.

text.ja: 露出が多くなって、防御面が気になるかもしれないけど、身体能力の向上で、ほとんどカバーできてるんだから
text.en: I know my exposure is increased, and defense might be a concern, but my enhanced physical abilities make up for it.

text.ja: 早く実戦での性能も試してみたいわ。訓練と試験では、問題なかったけど……敵を前にしないと、わからないこともあるもんね
text.en: I want to test my new abilities in actual combat as soon as possible. Training and simulations were fine, but there are things you can't know until you face a real enemy.

text.ja: ど、どうしたの、隊長……そんな、食い入るように見ちゃって……今回のデザイン、気に入っちゃったのかしら
text.en: W-what's wrong, Captain? You're staring at me so intensely... do you like this new design?

text.ja: マスクをしたら正体が分からなくなるのはお約束だと思うんだけど、結構普通に声かけられちゃうんだよね。なんかモヤッとするぅ……！
text.en: I thought it was a given that wearing a mask would hide my identity, but you can still tell who I am... it's kind of frustrating.

text.ja: 隊長っ……んぅっ、あんっ……なんか、いつもよりっ、はげしっ……ひぅっ、んっ、もうっ、ふふっ……いいわよ、好きにして？
text.en: C-captain... nnn, ah, you're more aggressive than usual... it's making me feel all funny inside...

text.ja: セクシーなコスチュームだと、興奮しちゃうわよね……それに、このマスクなら、キスも……ちゅっ……じゅるぅっ、れろぉぉ……
text.en: A sexy costume like this gets me excited... and with this mask, I can even kiss you... chu, juu, reo...

text.ja: はぁぁぁぁっ……やっ、んぅっ……顔、見ないでぇ……はぁっ、あんっ、あぁっ！　か、感じてる顔、丸見えになっちゃうぅ……
text.en: Ahhh, stop, don't look at my face... I'm feeling it so much, and my face is going to give me away...
